mechanical_bound.assumptions: Rent effect = -(units removed / renter households) x conversion share [0.25, 1] x inverse demand elasticity [1, 2]. Upper bound: assumes every delisted unit enters the long-term market at once. Units removed are PR-covered areas only; renter households are approximate 2021 Census totals for the City of Vancouver and the whole CRD (including exempt areas).
